title: Ubwiza bwarohamye
intro: Iyumvire iki kintu: umutima wambaye impuzu nziza kandi ukikujwe n’ubutunzi burengeye ubw’umuntu yokwiyumvira. Uwo muntu yarizera ko ubutunzi bwabo buronswa biciye ku bukerebutsi bwabo bwite, ntiyigera yemera isoko y’ibifungurwa vy’ukuri. Uwo muntu yagendagenda mu bayoboke b’umuhanuzi w’inkomezi, yaranse umuhamagaro wose wo kwicisha bugufi. Uyu musi, turahishura akaranga k’umuntu ubutunzi bwiwe bwiza cane bwacitse ikibanza cabo co kuruhukiramwo ca nyuma.
clues: Nabayeho mu gihe c’umuhanuzi yahamagaye ihanga ry’inkozi z’ikibi ku kuri.
Nari mu bagize umuryango watoranijwe, yamara umutima wanje warahindukiriye ubutumwa.
Inzahabu n’ifeza vyarankwegereye kuruta itegeko ryose ry’Imana.
Ivyumba vyanje vy’ubutunzi vyarakuze cane ku buryo umugwi w’abantu ukomeye wari ushobora guterura imfunguruzo ata co bimaze.
Nararata nti ubutunzi bwanje nabuhawe kubera ubumenyi bwanje bwite.
Amaherezo, jewe n’aho mba hose twamizwe n’isi nk’imburi.

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
